settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Adjust the interface language and general preferences. Changes apply immediately without a restart.
settings.languageHint: Pick the language for the desktop UI. Takes effect instantly and does not change the subtitle translation target.
settings.translationPreferenceHint: Set the target language for LLM translation output. Defaults to the interface language, or enter a custom language name.
settings.translationPreferenceCustomPlaceholder: Enter the target language, e.g. Japanese, French, Simplified Chinese
settings.overlayHint: Tune overlay opacity, colors, font and lock state.
settings.overlayPageSubtitle: Changes here are applied to the subtitle overlay immediately so you can fine-tune readability for games and videos.
settings.overlayPreviewHint: This preview updates in real time. If the overlay window is open, it will reflect the same changes.
settings.overlayPreviewTranslation: Translated subtitles appear on the next line
settings.overlayAppearanceHint: Overall opacity affects both the card and text, while background and text opacity can be tuned separately.
settings.overlayPresetHint: Start with a common subtitle style, then fine-tune its text effects.
settings.overlayTypographyHint: Adjust the font, size, opacity and subtitle alignment.
settings.overlayTextEffectsHint: Style source and translated text separately, or apply the current style to both.
settings.overlayLockHint: Lock the current position. Hover over the overlay to unlock it when you need to move it again.
settings.providersHint: Manage provider templates, credentials and probes. Open the Providers page for detailed configuration.
settings.resetWelcomeHint: Clear the local flag so the quick setup wizard appears again on next launch.
settings.resetWelcomeDone: Reset done. The wizard will appear next time.
settings.driverManagementHint: Manage the Omni Translate virtual speaker driver and Bridge Service.

welcome.title: Welcome to Omni Translate
welcome.subtitle: Pick a language, connect a provider, then check the driver and bridge. You can update these anytime from Settings.
welcome.hint: Pick a language from the list below; click to switch instantly.
welcome.stepProviderDescription: Choose a provider template and enter your API key to finish setup.
welcome.apiKeySaveTimeout: Saving the API key timed out, so the app could not confirm it was written to the local credential store. Check whether Windows Credential Manager is available, then try again.
welcome.apiKeySaveInvokeTimeout: The native API key save command did not return within 7 seconds. Check the console and diagnostics traces under storage or provider-runtime to confirm whether the request reached Rust.
welcome.apiKeySaveUiTimeout: The frontend has been waiting more than 15 seconds for the API key save result. The native command may still be running; check the console and diagnostics traces under storage or provider-runtime.
welcome.apiKeySavedDeferred: API key saved. DashScope realtime models should be validated after device and audio routing are ready, so you can continue with driver setup first.
welcome.apiKeyProbeFailed: API key saved, but the connectivity check did not pass. You can continue with driver setup now and retry later from Settings > Providers.
welcome.apiKeyProbeTimeout: API key saved, but the connectivity check timed out. Check the network, endpoint, and API key, or continue with driver setup now and retry later from Settings > Providers.
welcome.apiKeyRevealSuccess: Loaded the saved API key from the local credential store.
welcome.apiKeyRevealEmpty: No saved API key was found for the selected provider.
welcome.providerHint: The key is stored securely in the local credential store and can be managed later in Settings › Providers.
welcome.providerFootHint: No key right now? Skip this step and fill it in later from the Settings page.
welcome.stepDriverDescription: Check the virtual microphone driver and bridge before you start. You can install or repair them here.
welcome.driverFootHint: You can enter viewing mode now and continue repairs later from Settings > Driver management.
welcome.desktopRuntimeUnavailable: Desktop runtime initialization failed. Wait until Rust Core and storage recover before saving the API key. If it keeps failing, restart the app and try again.
welcome.desktopRuntimePreparing: Desktop runtime or storage is still initializing. Wait until the status is desktop runtime and storage is ready before saving the API key.

description.testSigningDisabled: Run .\scripts\installer\enable-test-signing.ps1 as administrator, restart Windows, then try again.
description.secureBootEnabled: Disable Secure Boot in BIOS/UEFI, enable TESTSIGNING, restart Windows, then try again.
description.memoryIntegrityEnabled: Disable Windows Security > Device security > Core isolation > Memory integrity, restart, then select Disable driver signature enforcement again.
description.rebootRequired: Windows created the driver device node, but a previous uninstall or install still has pending PnP configuration. Restart Windows, then detect or reinstall again.
description.audioProbeFailed: The driver device is present, but the install self-check did not capture the expected 1 kHz test tone or the virtual endpoint still has residual audio. Restart Windows, make sure no app is playing to Omni Translate Virtual Speaker, then detect or reinstall again.
description.bridgeDegraded: Bridge Service failed to start or complete its handshake. Run detection first; if it remains degraded, restart Bridge or reinstall the driver.
description.operationFailed: The most recent driver operation did not complete. The diagnostic summary below includes the extracted failure reason and log path; handle that issue and run detection again.
description.notInstalled: Install the virtual microphone driver to enable translated audio routing.
description.needsRepair: Repair the driver, then run detection again. Diagnostic details are available below.
description.bridgeStopped: Start the bridge service to connect the installed driver.

driverManagement.feedbackNeedsAttention: Detection completed. The driver still needs attention.
driverManagement.feedbackFailed: The driver operation failed. Open advanced details for the error code and recent log.

feedback.testSigningDisabled: Enable TESTSIGNING, restart Windows, then install the driver again.
feedback.secureBootEnabled: Secure Boot is blocking the test driver. Disable Secure Boot, enable TESTSIGNING, and restart Windows.
feedback.memoryIntegrityEnabled: Memory integrity is blocking driver loading. Disable memory integrity and restart Windows.
feedback.rebootRequired: Windows still has pending driver configuration. Restart Windows, then detect or reinstall again.
feedback.audioProbeFailed: Virtual speaker self-check failed. Restart Windows, make sure no app is playing to the virtual speaker, then detect or reinstall again.
feedback.bridgeDegraded: Bridge Service failed to start or handshake. Run detection; if it still fails, restart Bridge or reinstall the driver.
feedback.operationFailed: The driver operation did not complete. Check the diagnostic summary for the specific failure reason.
feedback.notInstalled: The driver is still not installed. Install the virtual speaker driver, then run detection.
feedback.needsRepair: The driver still needs repair. Reinstall the driver, then run detection.
feedback.bridgeStopped: The driver is available, but Bridge Service is not running. Start Bridge.

runtimeError.label: Desktop runtime not connected
runtimeError.summary: The frontend is inside the desktop shell, but invoke or event channels are not connected reliably. Real bridge, capture, and overlay status cannot be confirmed.

liveReady.label: Desktop runtime connected
liveReady.detail: The Session page starts scenes on demand. Diagnostics focuses only on low-level service faults.

liveActionNeeded.label: Low-level desktop chain has issues
liveActionNeeded.summary: The real desktop shell is active, but bridge or capture returned real errors that need attention.

sceneModels.emptyDescription: Choose a model from the model list or enter a model ID manually.

capabilityRegistry.title: Capability registry
capabilityRegistry.description: Register capabilities and realtime audio modes for unlisted models.
capabilityRegistry.emptyDescription: Add entries to supplement capabilities for custom models.

audioModeHelp.title: Realtime audio modes
audioModeHelp.description: Each mode controls how audio is segmented and sent to the server, affecting latency, sentence boundary accuracy, and protocol compatibility.

manualFullAudio.name: Manual full audio
manualFullAudio.description: The client sets turn_detection = null and commits complete local sentence audio segments, suited to Omni Realtime links that need explicit commit boundaries.
manualFullAudio.models: Models: qwen-omni-turbo-realtime, qwen3-omni-flash-realtime, qwen3.5-omni-plus-realtime and other Omni Realtime models

serverVad.name: Server VAD
serverVad.description: The server uses VAD (Voice Activity Detection) to detect speech start and end, usually committing after about 800 ms of silence. Suitable for OpenAI Realtime and DashScope live translation models.
serverVad.models: Models: qwen3-livetranslate series, GPT-4o realtime and similar

semanticVad.name: Semantic VAD
semanticVad.description: The server combines voice activity and semantic completeness to decide boundaries. Useful for dialog scenarios where clipped half-sentences should be reduced; eagerness defaults to auto.
semanticVad.models: Models: DashScope Omni models that support semantic_vad

geminiAuto.name: Gemini automatic activity detection
geminiAuto.description: Google Gemini Live WebSocket automaticActivityDetection lets the server decide activity boundaries and reduces local VAD/manual-boundary configuration.
geminiAuto.models: Models: gemini-2.5-flash-live and other Gemini Live models

geminiManual.name: Gemini manual activity boundaries
geminiManual.description: Disable Gemini Live automatic activity detection and let the client send activityStart / activityEnd. Useful when strict alignment with local segmentation is required.
